name: epotoken-wasm
description: EPoToken WASM binding — pure-compute primitives + JS-driven fetch + bgutils-js flow

scripts.build:wasm: emcmake cmake -B ../../build_wasm -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build ../../build_wasm --target epotoken_wasm && cp ../../build_wasm/epotoken_wasm.js ./epotoken.js && cp ../../build_wasm/epotoken_wasm.wasm ./epotoken.wasm
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:ts
